changes.summary: Added the First Circuit chief judge’s dismissal of the misconduct complaint arising from the transgender-care subpoena dispute.
Added the preliminary injunction staying and enjoining the August CPT directives for plaintiffs and member institutions.
Added Reitz’s confirmation of coordinated preliminary inquiries and Garcia’s twelve prospective preservation letters.

evidence_extracts.cpt_order: The November 17 order found a likely unacknowledged change in CPT interpretation and stayed and enjoined the broadcasts for plaintiffs and their members pending review.
evidence_extracts.misconduct_order: The September 28 order dismissed Complaint 01-26-90041 as baseless and not cognizable after reviewing the underlying record.
evidence_extracts.oversight_status: Reitz described preliminary inquiries with no assigned prosecutor and Main Justice coordination; Garcia’s November 18 letters preserve records for future oversight and are not subpoenas or findings.
